description: Remove the cart icon from the customer menu topbar and make the floating cart FAB always visible on all screen sizes. The topbar cart is an inline-styled .cart-fab element inside the menu template's own nav section (NOT in base.html). The bottom floating cart is currently conditional on {% if cart_count %}, which hides it when the cart is empty — fix by always rendering it, using a server-rendered style='display:none' on the badge when count is 0.
steps: In templates/menu/index.html, locate the topbar <nav> element (first element in {% block body %}). Inside the <div style='display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px'>, remove the entire <a href='{% url 'orders:cart' %}' class='cart-fab' style='position:relative;width:42px;height:42px;font-size:1.1rem;bottom:unset;right:unset;box-shadow:var(--shadow)'> element including its children. Keep the Staff Login / Dashboard <a> tag.

In templates/menu/index.html, locate the floating cart block near the bottom (just before the chatbot comment). Replace the entire {% if cart_count %}...{% endif %} block with an unconditional FAB that always renders. Add id='cart-fab-badge' to the badge span and apply style='display:none' when cart_count is falsy: 🛒 {{ cart_count }}

In static/css/chatbot.css, update the @media (max-width: 480px) rule for .kdm-chat-btn: change bottom from 80px to 90px to restore the clear gap above the cart FAB (which is at bottom:20px + height:56px = 76px top edge; 90px provides 14px gap).
acceptance_criteria: The topbar on the customer menu page shows only the logo and Staff Login/Dashboard link — no cart icon.
The floating cart FAB is visible at bottom-right on all screen sizes including 320px, 360px, 375px, 390px, 412px.
When the cart is empty, the FAB shows no red badge.
When the cart has items, the FAB shows the red badge with the correct count.
The chatbot button and cart FAB do not overlap on mobile viewports.
python manage.py check reports no errors.
verification: Manual: open menu page with empty cart — FAB visible, badge hidden. Topbar has no cart icon.
